title: Masmark part ways with estellyy., sign HikariiFloofie
author: BPL Staff
body:
[Masmark](#/team/masmark) have made a change to their active roster, releasing AWPer [estellyy.](#/player/estellyy) and signing free-agent rifler [HikariiFloofie](#/player/hikariifloofie) in her place.

The move trims a double-AWP setup — estellyy. had shared the sniping role with **Xyrolizea** — and brings in a Malaysian rifler off strong recent form (a 64% win rate and a 1.12 K/D). She slots into an all-SEA core alongside Xyrolizea, XueHuaVT, urnisa_ and kn.

estellyy. departs as a free agent after a run with the team stretching back to 2023. We wish her the best in finding her next home.

The swap takes effect immediately.
